patterns.what_worked: Reading all five secret-wave reports (matrix, consumers audit, three fix reports) before writing meant every sentence traced to a named evidence line; the final gate numbers came from the fix reports' own runs (57/0, luacheck 2/0) rather than being inferred from the dispatch. The existing 2.1.8 section already had the right skeleton (verification status + Fixed/Changed), so the extension slotted in as a `Hardening` subsection matching the file's historical usage.
patterns.what_was_hard: Compressing five reports into one compact block without dropping the user-visible outcomes: the internal helper names are numerous, so the README kept outcomes and the CHANGELOG kept the API surface in a single compat bullet. Also had to keep the earlier power-bar StatusBar bullet intact while making the hardening block non-duplicative.
patterns.skill_gap: No doc-claim tracer: the claim map is hand-written report-to-sentence links, so the next docs session must re-read the reports. A generated table would help, but it is outside a prose lane's write scope.
